兄.note: 兄弟 (xiōngdì) means brothers. 兄 stacks a small 口 over two spreading strokes called 儿. Keep the upper box centered between the two lower strokes.
兄.memory: 兄 stacks a small 口 over two spreading strokes called 儿. Keep the upper box centered between the two lower strokes.

parts.label: 口
parts.name: 口 component
parts.description: The first three strokes form the small mouth-shaped box at the top. This is a visual shape cue, not a literal story about brothers.

parts.label: 儿
parts.name: 儿 component
parts.description: Below the box, a left slant and a right hooked stroke spread apart to support the upper component.

漂.note: 漂亮 (piàoliàng) means pretty; beautiful. 漂 is 氵 beside 票. The right side stacks a compact covered box above a wider 示-shaped base. In 漂亮, read 漂 with a fourth tone.
漂.memory: 漂 is 氵 beside 票. The right side stacks a compact covered box above a wider 示-shaped base. In 漂亮, read 漂 with a fourth tone.

parts.label: 氵
parts.name: 氵 component
parts.description: The three water strokes run down the left edge. Treat them as a recognizable component; they do not literally explain the meaning pretty.

parts.label: 票
parts.name: 票 component
parts.description: 票 is the larger right side, with a covered box above a spreading lower group. Keep its internal spaces open despite the many strokes.

亮.meaning: bright; second syllable of 漂亮
亮.note: 漂亮 (piàoliàng) means pretty; beautiful. 亮 stacks 亠, 口 and a cover over two lower legs. The dot at the very top and the hooked leg at the bottom help you remember its outline.
亮.memory: 亮 stacks 亠, 口 and a cover over two lower legs. The dot at the very top and the hooked leg at the bottom help you remember its outline.

parts.label: 亠口
parts.name: 亠口 component
parts.description: A dot and horizontal make 亠, followed by a small 口 directly underneath. Keep these five strokes centered.

parts.label: 冖几
parts.name: 冖几 component
parts.description: A two-stroke cover sits above two spreading lower strokes. Leave a gap beneath the cover for the lower legs.
